Meanwhile the fresh 2026-07-26 sector bar still cleanly ranks RRG momentum (XLE Leading, quad L, accel +2.32, rsMom 102.92, rsMom1m +8.41; XLK index-leader but Lagging, rsMom1m -3.74) and real-assets still ranks per-model trend momentum (PDBC 70.6 / USO 66.3 firm; havens soft GLD 14 / SLV 0 / BTC-USD 39). The non-standard pattern is a degraded-input FALLBACK: when the dedicated momentum owner is unavailable, reconstruct a coarse factor-momentum proxy from the still-fresh sector rsMom ordering blended with real-assets per-model momentum, explicitly LABELED a proxy and never presented as the native ETF ranking, rather than silently carrying a stale prior-bar ranking. Persistence and native-vs-proxy agreement are counted across DISTINCT market-bar dates, never repeated intraday runs.
experimental.method: On each fresh market-bar date, detect owning-tool read failure (metrics.error present / undefined-symbol / empty ranking). When failed, compute a proxy momentum vector = rank(sector rsMom across the 11 GICS sectors) blended with rank(real-assets per-model mom21/mom63/mom126), emit it flagged as a proxy with the failure reason, and withhold any native-ETF-ranking claim. On dates when the native etf-momentum read exists, measure rank-agreement (e.g. Spearman) between the proxy and the native ranking to calibrate how trustworthy the fallback is. State-transition and agreement deltas are measured across distinct market-bar dates.
inputs: etf-momentum-lab read status / metrics.error flag (this run: 'RLMACROROTATION is not defined')
sector-research-lab per-sector rsMom / rsRatio / accel / quad from the fresh 2026-07-26 bar (proxy momentum ordering)
real-assets-lab per-model mom21 / mom63 / mom126 (PDBC / DBC / DBA / USO / BNO / CPER / GLD / SLV / IBIT / BTC-USD) as the cross-sleeve momentum leg
native etf-momentum ranking on dates when it is available, for proxy-vs-native rank-agreement calibration
distinct-market-bar-date persistence, never repeated intraday runs
